description: Lists who has access to a Google Drive file or folder and at what role. Takes the file ID. Returns one entry per permission: its ID, its type (user, group, domain or anyone), the role (owner, organizer, fileOrganizer, writer, commenter or reader), and the person's name and address or the domain where there is one. A file the account cannot see answers as not found.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

file_id.description: The Google Drive file or folder ID.

name: gws-mcp__drive_get_file_permissions
